global_context.certifications: Experienced field technicians with hands-on time across the major CNC OEM platforms, in-house precision spindle balancing capability, laser alignment services, and established relationships with aftermarket bearing and spindle component suppliers.
global_context.customer_quote: "Honestly, we thought the machine was done for." Most customers are relieved to avoid replacement lead times and six-figure capital expenses.
global_context.terminology_guidance: Your terminology is generally solid. In some cases 'front bearing wear' could be broadened to 'bearing pack failure' because preload loss and heat damage often affect multiple bearings.
global_context.emphasis_themes: Emphasize downtime reduction, field troubleshooting capability, crash recovery experience, and ability to support legacy machines with limited OEM support.

ken_input.common_failure_mode: Hydraulic service and ram alignment issues are probably the most common calls
ken_input.typical_lead_time: Simple alignments can be turned around quickly. Major hydraulic work is usually 2-4 weeks
ken_input.brand_specifics: Tooling condition matters more than a lot of operators think. We see machines blamed for problems that are really worn tooling or setup issues
ken_input.war_story: Had a brake that operators swore was mechanically bad. Ended up being inconsistent tooling setup between shifts.

ken_input.common_failure_mode: Mostly straightforward bearing failures and occasional lubrication contamination.
ken_input.brand_specifics: Value-oriented Taiwanese machines. Pretty serviceable overall.
ken_input.war_story: Caught contamination in the lubrication system before it damaged the shaft.

ken_input.common_failure_mode: High RPM bearing wear. Those machines accelerate and decelerate so fast that heat becomes a big factor.
ken_input.brand_specifics: The Speedio machines are compact but they run hard. Warmup routines matter more than a lot of shops realize.
ken_input.war_story: Saw one machine eat bearings early because operators were cold-starting straight into production every morning.

ken_input.common_failure_mode: Most of the expensive failures are in the motor spindle assemblies — bearings, encoder issues, cooling jacket contamination, and occasional crash-related taper damage.
ken_input.typical_lead_time: Usually 4–6 weeks. Encoder availability and OEM parts can stretch timelines.
ken_input.brand_specifics: These machines are tightly integrated. After a rebuild, we usually verify spindle cooling performance and monitor thermal growth before signoff.
ken_input.war_story: Had one NHX machine where the customer kept getting intermittent spindle alarms after another shop rebuilt it. Turned out the spindle chiller flow was restricted and overheating the cartridge.

ken_input.common_failure_mode: Pretty standard bearing-pack wear in most cases. We also see damage from shops pushing aggressive roughing cycles without proper warmup.
ken_input.brand_specifics: Good parts availability compared to a lot of imports. Common machines in Midwest production shops.
ken_input.war_story: Customer started noticing surface finish problems on a Puma long before the spindle actually failed. Caught it early enough to avoid shaft damage.

brands.legacy_context: Manufacturer is defunct; pages should mention support for legacy machines still in service and parts sourcing capabilities.

ken_input.common_failure_mode: Classic belt-driven spindle failures, drawbar fatigue, and occasional ATC alignment problems.
ken_input.brand_specifics: Still a huge installed base. Plenty of shops keep these alive because repair costs make sense.
ken_input.war_story: Had a 4020 come in with enough noise that the customer assumed the spindle was junk. Shaft cleaned up fine after teardown.
ken_input.parts_situation: A lot of Fadal parts come through aftermarket suppliers and used inventory. We also salvage usable OEM components whenever possible.

ken_input.common_failure_mode: High-speed bearing fatigue and taper wear from nonstop production use.
ken_input.brand_specifics: The controls side is usually straightforward because most maintenance teams already know Fanuc.
ken_input.war_story: One Robodrill started throwing intermittent vibration alarms only at higher RPM. Bearings looked decent until teardown showed preload loss.

ken_input.common_failure_mode: Large spindle-bearing failures and ram-drive wear.
ken_input.brand_specifics: Downtime on these machines is brutal because they’re usually tied to big-part production.
ken_input.war_story: One customer was losing thousands a day while a boring mill sat idle waiting on diagnosis.

ken_input.common_failure_mode: Confirmed. Belt-driven VF spindles commonly show drawbar wear, pulley issues, and bearing fatigue. Direct-drive units mainly fail from bearing wear and heat.
ken_input.typical_lead_time: 2–3 weeks on most Haas spindle rebuilds due to strong domestic parts availability.
ken_input.brand_specifics: Very common in Midwest job shops. Older Haas machines are often repairable at reasonable cost compared to replacement.
ken_input.war_story: Recovered a crashed VF spindle where the taper damage looked catastrophic. Saved the shaft and returned the machine to production instead of replacement.

brands.legacy_context: Manufacturer is defunct; pages should mention support for legacy machines still in service and parts sourcing capabilities.

ken_input.common_failure_mode: The biggest issue is usually obsolete components and aging bearings.
ken_input.typical_lead_time: 5–7 weeks because sourcing can take time.
ken_input.brand_specifics: These machines are old enough now that every rebuild is a little different.
ken_input.war_story: Had to reverse-engineer part of a spindle assembly because OEM support was long gone.
ken_input.parts_situation: Combination of used-market sourcing, remanufacturing, and custom-machined replacement parts.

ken_input.common_failure_mode: Older belt-driven machines come in with pulley and drawbar wear. Newer machines are more typical bearing failures.
ken_input.brand_specifics: Very common in smaller job shops where one machine may run ten different kinds of work in a week.
ken_input.war_story: Saved a VMX spindle after a toolholder failure damaged the taper. Customer expected a full replacement.

ken_input.common_failure_mode: Bearing-pack wear and taper damage from crash events.
ken_input.brand_specifics: Heavy Taiwanese-built machines with decent rigidity for the price.
ken_input.war_story: Recovered a crashed spindle another company had quoted as replacement-only.

ken_input.common_failure_mode: Precision bearing wear, usually noticed first as finish issues or heat drift before outright failure.
ken_input.typical_lead_time: 4–6 weeks because these are tighter-tolerance rebuilds.
ken_input.brand_specifics: A lot of Makino work comes from aerospace and mold shops where even small runout issues become visible fast.
ken_input.war_story: Had a mold customer chasing a finish problem for weeks before teardown showed early-stage bearing damage.

ken_input.common_failure_mode: Confirmed. Front bearing wear and coolant intrusion are common, especially on high-coolant-production work. We also see encoder contamination and spindle chiller issues.
ken_input.typical_lead_time: 3–5 weeks is realistic depending on cartridge damage and OEM bearing availability.
ken_input.brand_specifics: MAZATROL diagnostics are brand-specific. Integrex machines require careful spindle alignment after rebuild due to multitasking tolerances.
ken_input.war_story: Rebuilt an Integrex spindle after coolant contamination wiped out the front bearing pack. Customer had crash concerns, but geometry checked out after rebuild.

brands.legacy_context: Monarch Machine Tool's CNC lathe business effectively ended in the 1990s. Many older Monarch machines remain in service, particularly in shops where the original mechanical build quality justifies ongoing rebuild and restoration work over replacement.

ken_input.common_failure_mode: Bearing wear and vibration issues tied to aging gearbox assemblies.
ken_input.brand_specifics: Some of these machines are old enough that maintaining accuracy becomes half rebuild, half restoration work.
ken_input.war_story: Restored spindle accuracy on an older machine the customer still used for tight-tolerance repair work.

brands.control_system: MSX-501 or MSG-501 on older machines; Siemens / Heidenhain on newer

ken_input.common_failure_mode: Older belt-drive setups tend to come in with pulley wear and tired bearings. Newer direct-drive units usually show heat damage or preload loss.
ken_input.brand_specifics: A lot of the older standalone Mori machines are still extremely solid mechanically and worth rebuilding.
ken_input.war_story: One customer was ready to scrap an older Mori horizontal because of chatter. After rebuild and alignment work, it went right back into production.

ken_input.common_failure_mode: Heavy-duty spindle bearing wear and gear-drive vibration issues.
ken_input.brand_specifics: A lot of these are production machines running large parts for long cycles.
ken_input.war_story: Shop had been fighting chatter for months before teardown confirmed support-bearing wear.

ken_input.common_failure_mode: Integrated motor spindle bearing wear is common, especially on higher RPM applications. Cooling system maintenance is critical.
ken_input.brand_specifics: OSP controls require machine-specific diagnostics. Thermal growth management is more critical on Okuma than many builders.
ken_input.war_story: Customer chased chatter for months before spindle teardown revealed early-stage front bearing degradation.

ken_input.common_failure_mode: Mostly bearing-pack wear and occasional lubrication-related damage.
ken_input.brand_specifics: Very rigid machines. We don't see them as often, but when we do they're usually worth fixing.
ken_input.war_story: Customer thought they had a tooling problem. Ended up being spindle preload starting to go away.

ken_input.common_failure_mode: Optics contamination, resonator issues on older CO2 machines, and cooling-related laser faults
ken_input.brand_specifics: Trumpf support and parts are very OEM-centric compared to standard CNC equipment, so planning downtime matters
ken_input.war_story: Tracked an intermittent cut-quality issue back to contamination in the optics path that only showed up under longer runs.
